notablePrerequisites:
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
 Delina does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Sage of Hours that enters the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate the Sage of Hours token by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
